params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 could hit 55 million sales by March, analysts say Investor's Business Daily gathered analyst reports on GTA 6 and Take-Two ahead of the November 19 launch. BMO Capital Markets' Brian Pitz expects 55 million copies sold in Take-Two's fiscal 2027 (ending March 31, 2027), with 45 million in the launch quarter alone. The report also suggests an average selling price of around $90. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 22:36 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @RockstarGames 🔥 React if you think it breaks every record · 💬 How many millions in week one? #GTA6 #Rockstar #TakeTwo #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
